settings.question: What is the Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) for bulk discounts?
settings.answer: Our commercial volume pricing starts at 10 units or a minimum project order value of ₹1,00,000. Discounts increase from 15% up to 40% based on total quantity.

settings.question: Can we request wood finish swatches and prototype samples?
settings.answer: Yes! For verified architectural and commercial projects, we courier physical wood sample boxes (Natural Teak, Walnut, Dark Oak, Linseed Oil) and can manufacture paid pre-production prototypes.

settings.question: What are your standard manufacturing lead times for bulk orders?
settings.answer: Standard catalog items in volume typically dispatch in 10-18 business days. Custom architectural designs and high-volume runs (100+ units) require 3-5 weeks from CAD approval.

settings.question: Do you provide official GST invoices with input tax credit?
settings.answer: Yes, 100%. We provide compliant B2B tax invoices with your company GSTIN, HSN codes, and transport e-Way bills so you can claim full GST input credit.

settings.question: How is pan-India delivery and on-site assembly handled?
settings.answer: All bulk freight is insured in heavy-duty wooden crating. We coordinate site delivery directly with your project manager, including lift placement and assembly technicians.
